gap-runtime.contract: Adjacent gaps match as a single zero-or-more-cell span, including random candidate weights, random-stream consumption, fixed-cell edits and persistent undo.

source-faults.contract: An empty sound fallback after a consumed heading emits a structured error. Comment recovery preserves later sections or diagnoses their absence; it does not throw a host-language null exception.

limitations: Five historical golden disagreements keep the gameplay verifier nonzero.

Two pinned source-compiler null exceptions keep the section diagnostic audit nonzero. Separate recovery contracts verify candidate diagnostics and recovery/rejection without counting incomplete reference outcomes as parity.
Finite passing audits and constructed campaigns do not prove compatibility for every possible source program.
The pinned reference throws when matching adjacent gaps. A separately counted component contract treats them as a single gap, including random weights and undo; this is not reference runtime parity.
Rendering, synthesized audio, editor UI and device input are outside the headless component. Sound requests and ordered persistence effects are implemented.
Compatibility targets the pinned vanilla revision and Unicode data version; newer authorities require separate validation.
